title: Pantheon InstitutionalMemoryEntry
description: Shared institutional memory entry. Captures lessons, patterns, and policy updates that are system-wide rather than persona-specific. Written by authorised services after postmortem, evolution, or research publication events; readable by all active personas, research sessions, and consultation sessions.

entry_id.description: Immutable unique identifier for this institutional memory entry. Format: mem-{UUID} (e.g. mem-7f2a1b9c-4d5e-4f6a-8b0c-9d1e2f3a4b5c). The mem- prefix makes the ID self-describing in a multi-entity system.

knowledge_type.description:
Classification of the institutional knowledge.
- incident_lesson: a lesson extracted from a published postmortem
- regime_pattern: a market-regime pattern confirmed across multiple personas
- policy_precedent: a governance or risk-policy decision that sets a precedent
- research_finding: a validated insight from a completed research task
- evolution_rationale: the reasoning behind a system-level EvolutionDecision
- cross_persona_observation: a behavioural pattern observed across multiple personas, typically written when a consultation session closes

headline.description: One-sentence summary suitable for retrieval ranking display.

body.description: Full narrative of the institutional knowledge.

structured_payload.description: Optional machine-readable payload (e.g. quantitative finding, regime label, affected personas).

source_event_type.description: The class of platform event that produced this entry.

source_event_id.description: ID of the specific source event (e.g. postmortem_id, evolution_decision_id, task_id).

contributing_persona_ids.description: Persona IDs whose sessions or outcomes contributed to this entry, if applicable.

written_at.description: Timestamp when this entry was written (UTC ISO-8601).

write_authority.description: Service that wrote this entry. Only whitelisted services may write to the institutional index.

scope.description:
Breadth of applicability.
- system_wide: applies to all personas and planes
- strategy_family: applies only to personas sharing the same strategy_family
- instrument_class: applies only to sessions trading a specific instrument class

scope_filter.description: When scope is strategy_family or instrument_class, the specific value (e.g. 'momentum', 'equity_futures'). Null for system_wide.

embedding_ref.description: Reference to the vector embedding in the institutional retrieval index.

superseded_by.description: entry_id that supersedes this one. Superseded entries are kept for lineage but excluded from active retrieval.

expires_at.description: UTC timestamp after which the retention policy archives this entry unless it has already been superseded or archived. Null means the entry follows an explicit indefinite-retention exception.

archived_at.description: UTC timestamp when the retention policy archived this entry. Archived entries remain durable for lineage and replay but are excluded from active retrieval.

archived_reason.description: Reason recorded when the entry was archived, for example retention_ttl_expired.

reuse_count.description: How many times a retrieval query has surfaced this entry, incremented by the retrieval facade. Used to rank high-value institutional knowledge.
